title: Natural comparisons for fixed balanced tensor complexes
statement: Let R,A,Aq,B,D be commutative rings in one universe with compatible R -> A -> Aq algebra structures, R -> B, algebra structures (A tensor_R B) -> D and (Aq tensor_R B) -> D, and derived categories for R-modules and B-modules. Let Q be an A-module cochain complex, L a base-derived R-to-B tensor cohomology model for Q, and K one for Aq tensor_A Q [def-pc-base-derived-tensor-cohomology-model]. Let uQ be the R-linear degreewise unit x -> 1 tensor x [lem-pc-first-localization-cohomology-semilinear]. Supply a quasi-isomorphism f:F -> B[0] with F an R-K-flat cochain complex [def-pc-module-kflat-complex]. Set C=Tot(Q tensor_R F) and Cq=Tot((Aq tensor_A Q) tensor_R F) using the explicit mixed total tensors [def-pc-mixed-total-tensor]. Supply an Aq-linear chain isomorphism theta:Aq tensor_A C -> Cq which sends 1 tensor (x tensor (1 tensor y)) to (1 tensor x) tensor (1 tensor y) on each diagonal summand. For every integer i there are A-linear isomorphisms e from L.cohomology(i), restricted along A -> A tensor_R B, to H^i(C), and eq from K.cohomology(i), restricted along A -> Aq -> Aq tensor_R B, to H^i(restrict_A Cq). They satisfy eq(localizationModelMap(x))=H^i(unit_C followed by restrict_A(theta))(e(x)). The complexes C and Cq are these fixed constructions, not arbitrary complexes with the same cohomology. The termwise extension and restriction functors are those of def-pc-ring-tensor-cohomology.

proof.text: Compute the derived tensor using the supplied K-flat F. Resolve the underlying R-complex of each first factor by P. K-flatness of F identifies Tot(P tensor_R F) with Tot(Q tensor_R F); K-flatness of P identifies it with Tot(P tensor_R B[0]). The latter is ordinary extension to B. The universal counits compare this with L.derived and K.derived. The counit on the R-K-flat resolution P is invertible by lem-pc-kflat-scalar-extension-counit; naturality for P -> Q transports the comparison. P here resolves the underlying R-complex, not an A-K-flat complex mistakenly regarded as R-K-flat.

Naturality for multiplication by a in A, together with the cohomologyIso_smul fields, upgrades the comparisons to A-linear isomorphisms. The pure-tensor formula shows unit_C followed by theta is uQ tensored with F. Naturality of the resolution comparisons and uniqueness of the universal-counit comparison identify its cohomology map with localizationModelMap.

theorem exists_balancedTensorUnitModelComparison (i : ℤ)
    (Q : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ)
    (L : ModuleCat.BaseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel R A B Q D)
    (K : ModuleCat.BaseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel R Aq B ((extend A Aq).obj Q) D)
    (uQ : (restrict R A).obj Q ⟶ (restrict R Aq).obj ((extend A Aq).obj Q))
    (huQ : ∀ (j : ℤ) (x : Q.X j), uQ.f j x = (1 : Aq) ⊗ₜ[A,algebraMap A Aq] x)
    (F : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} R) ℤ)
    (f : F ⟶ (CochainComplex.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} R) (0 : ℤ)).obj
      (ModuleCat.of R B))
    (hf : QuasiIso f)
    (hF : (HomologicalComplex.quasiIso (ModuleCat.{u} R) (.up ℤ)).kFlat F)
    (θ : (extend A Aq).obj
        (((ModuleCat.mixedTotalTensor (algebraMap R A)).obj Q).obj F) ≅
      ((ModuleCat.mixedTotalTensor (algebraMap R Aq)).obj ((extend A Aq).obj Q)).obj F)
    (hθ :
    ∀ (p q n : ℤ) (h : p + q = n) (x : Q.X p) (y : F.X q),
      θ.hom.f n ((1 : Aq) ⊗ₜ[A,algebraMap A Aq]
        ((HomologicalComplex.ιMapBifunctor Q F
          (ModuleCat.mixedTensor (algebraMap R A)) (.up ℤ) p q n h)
            (x ⊗ₜ[A] ((1 : A) ⊗ₜ[R,algebraMap R A] y)))) =
      (HomologicalComplex.ιMapBifunctor ((extend A Aq).obj Q) F
        (ModuleCat.mixedTensor (algebraMap R Aq)) (.up ℤ) p q n h)
          (((1 : Aq) ⊗ₜ[A,algebraMap A Aq] x) ⊗ₜ[Aq]
            ((1 : Aq) ⊗ₜ[R,algebraMap R Aq] y))) :
    let C := ((ModuleCat.mixedTotalTensor (algebraMap R A)).obj Q).obj F
    let Cq := ((ModuleCat.mixedTotalTensor (algebraMap R Aq)).obj
      ((extend A Aq).obj Q)).obj F
    ∃ (e : (ModuleCat.restrictScalars
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft (S := R) : A →ₐ[R] A ⊗[R] B).toRingHom).obj
          (L.cohomology i) ≅ C.homology i)
      (eq : (ModuleCat.restrictScalars
        ((Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft (S := R) : Aq →ₐ[R] Aq ⊗[R] B).toRingHom.comp
          (algebraMap A Aq))).obj (K.cohomology i) ≅ ((restrict A Aq).obj Cq).homology i),
      ∀ x : L.cohomology i,
        eq.hom (localizationModelMap R A Aq B D i Q L K uQ x) =
          (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
            ((((ModuleCat.extendRestrictScalarsAdj (algebraMap A Aq)).mapHomologicalComplex
              (.up ℤ)).unit.app C) ≫ (restrict A Aq).map θ.hom) i) (e.hom x)
